description.text: Starter Set ex Eevee ex, released on 31 July 2026 with Zorua & Zoroark ex's and Sprigatito & Meowscarada ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck of Eevee ex and Lightning Pokémon, with two Eevee ex and a full-illustration Eevee. Eevee ex, a Basic Pokémon with 200 HP, has one attack that draws three cards and another that does 200 damage, with a coin flip that may do 30 to itself. Jolteon and the Pawmi line join it, and once a turn Pawmot's Ability attaches a basic Lightning Energy from the discard pile to one of your Pokémon. Damage counters and markers of paper, a coin and a playmat of its own, a player's guide and a how-to-play booklet came with it, and some of its cards are reprints from earlier series.
